order_wins: **Larsen & Toubro** — its PT&D arm wins 380 kV transmission and substation orders in Saudi Arabia, 132/11 kV substations in the UAE and a Visakhapatnam transmission system, together in L&T's "Mega" band of **Rs 10,000-15,000 crore** _(>=~1.9% of mcap at the band floor)_.

**Marine Electricals (India)** — bags **four orders aggregating Rs 393.52 crore** from Web Werks (power distribution), CtrlS Datacenters (MEP works), Garden Reach Shipbuilders (7500 DWT vessel electricals) and Navayuga Engineering (VTMS, Ramayapatnam Port) _(~6.4% of mcap)_.

**Aurionpro Solutions** — wins a **Rs 150 crore follow-on order from a global hyperscaler** for an AI-ready data centre in Navi Mumbai, its third project from the customer in under a year _(~4.5% of mcap)_.

**Laser Power & Infra** — secures its first commercial HTLS-conductor order, **Rs 72.76 crore from Power Grid**, to reconductor ~164 circuit-km of two 132 kV lines under NERES-XXIV within 12 months _(~1.9% of mcap)_.
**A B Infrabuild** — receives a letter of acceptance for a **Rs 48.10 crore EPC order from the Government of Chhattisgarh** for two grade separators on NH-53, over 18 months _(~6.0% of mcap)_.

**Optivalue Tek Consulting** — Aroosha Technologies expands the government-website order disclosed on 10 September from Rs 16.25 crore to Rs 64.00 crore incl. GST, an increase of **Rs 47.75 crore** (our arithmetic) _(~9.5% of mcap)_.

**BCPL Railway Infrastructure** — bags a **Rs 37.26 crore order from Eastern Railway's Asansol division** to replace overaged electrification structures in the Waria-Raniganj section, over 12 months _(~33.1% of mcap)_.

**INDO SMC** — receives a **Rs 31.71 crore purchase order** (excl. tax) from a Gujarat-based power-distribution manufacturer for fuse and mini section pillars, to be supplied within 4-5 weeks _(~2.8% of mcap)_.
**Solex Energy** — secures a **new Rs 13.16 crore order for TopCon bifacial glass-to-glass solar modules** from a domestic entity, for delivery by November 2026 _(~1.8% of mcap)_.
**TechD Cybersecurity** — wins its **largest single order to date, Rs 13.08 crore incl. GST for a 3-year BFSI platform engagement**, taking its order book to Rs 70 crore _(~3.3% of mcap)_.
**ARC Insulation & Insulators** — bags **two GFRP-rebar orders aggregating Rs 9.71 crore** from MRA Composites and NKT Infra _(~30.7% of mcap)_.
**Eleganz Interiors** — wins a **Rs 6.93 crore civil and interior fit-out contract from an undisclosed Mumbai-based media conglomerate**, due April 2027 _(~3.7% of mcap)_.
**Gujarat Inject (Kerala)** — secures a **Rs 4.86 crore order** (excl. GST) from Zentaraa Infra Projects for 3,600 solar PV modules, for execution in October 2026 _(~3.6% of mcap)_.
**Deem Roll-Tech** — receives an **export purchase order for rolls from an overseas customer, stated only as exceeding Rs 1 crore** _(>=~2.5% of mcap at the floor)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **D. P. Abhushan** — board approves a preferential issue of up to Rs 123.90 crore of equity and Rs 434.11 crore of warrants at Rs 1,430 each (**Rs 558.01 crore together**, our sum), subject to shareholder approval at an EGM.

**Pro Fin Capital Services** — board approves issuing up to 33 crore convertible warrants at Rs 2.80 each to proposed public allottees, **up to Rs 92.40 crore** _(~55.4% of mcap)_, subject to shareholder approval at an EGM.

**Trident Lifeline** — board approves a preferential issue of Rs 41.14 crore of equity to public investors and up to Rs 16.84 crore of warrants, at Rs 336.60 (**Rs 57.98 crore together**, our sum; ~12.5% of mcap), subject to an EGM on 27 October.
**Fratelli Vineyards** — files a draft letter of offer for a rights issue of partly paid-up equity shares of **up to Rs 30 crore** _(~5.4% of mcap)_, approved by its board on 1 October.
equity_allotments: **Piramal Finance** — allots **82,94,000 fresh warrants to promoter-group entity Nithyam Realty for an aggregate Rs 1,750.03 crore**, of which Rs 437.51 crore (25%) is received now, on a preferential basis.
**Alankit** — allots **5 crore fresh convertible warrants to promoter-group entity Alka Agarwal at Rs 8.60 each, for Rs 43.00 crore** _(~20.7% of mcap)_, on a preferential basis.
**CWD** — allots 2,48,329 shares on conversion of warrants issued earlier (plus 9,93,316 bonus shares due on them) on receipt of the 75% balance, **Rs 16.89 crore** _(~2.5% of mcap)_.
**CLN Energy** — allots 2,50,000 new shares at Rs 423 to promoter CLN Energy PTE on a preferential basis, for **Rs 10.575 crore** _(~2.1% of mcap)_.
**Rita Finance and Leasing** — allots 50,65,000 shares on conversion of warrants issued earlier on a preferential basis, taking paid-up capital to Rs 15.065 crore.
m_and_a: **Marico** — buys a further **24.09% of subsidiary Satiya Nutraceuticals (Plix) for Rs 1,012.03 crore**, taking its holding from 60% to 84.09%, under agreements for 38.18% in tranches from the founders.

**Imagicaaworld Entertainment** — signs a binding MoU to sell **Hotel Novotel Imagicaa, Khopoli, to Juniper Hotels for a lumpsum Rs 248.00 crore** _(~8.6% of mcap)_, subject to shareholder postal-ballot approval.

**Juniper Hotels** — agrees to **acquire the operating Hotel Novotel Imagicaa, Khopoli, from Imagicaaworld for Rs 248.00 crore** _(~5.2% of mcap)_, under a binding MoU subject to definitive documents.
**Frog Innovations** — will buy 100% of **VLS Developers for Rs 36.00 crore** _(~9.1% of mcap)_ instead of the land and building VLS owns, restructuring the purchase it disclosed on 11 June.
**Restile Ceramics** — calls an EGM on 28 October to approve its proposed acquisition of 98.89% of Bell Granito Ceramica through a cash-plus-share swap, raising authorised capital to Rs 320 crore.

**Sai Parenterals** — completes the acquisition of **60% of R&D platform Prathyak Laboratories (Genome Valley, Hyderabad) for Rs 15 crore** from unutilised IPO proceeds, in place of its planned greenfield research centre.
**Dr. Agarwal's Health Care** — NCLT Chennai sanctions the amalgamation of listed Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital into it, appointed date 1 April 2026; the record date and share allotment are to follow.

**Kothari Petrochemicals / Kothari Sugars and Chemicals** — NCLT Chennai orders shareholder and unsecured-creditor meetings on 13 November on the amalgamation of Kothari Sugars into Kothari Petrochemicals; the secured creditor has consented.

**AXISCADES Technologies** — places loss-making German step-down subsidiary add-solution (1.35% of FY26 consolidated turnover, net worth minus Rs 14.37 crore) into voluntary solvent liquidation, ending its automotive engineering exposure.
capex_core: **Nelcast** — board approves a **machining division at Gudur, Andhra Pradesh for ~Rs 75 crore** _(~7.1% of mcap)_, funded by internal accruals and borrowings, to machine its own castings.
business_updates: **Results season** — 10 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Raymond Realty** — Q2 FY27 pre-sales nearly double, +98% YoY to Rs 902 crore, and collections rise 67% to Rs 682 crore; H1 pre-sales reach Rs 1,602 crore, up 111%.
**Embassy Developments** — records **Rs 1,800 crore of pre-sales at the launch of Embassy Origins**, a new residential project.
**Trent** — Q2 FY27 standalone revenue rises 23% YoY to Rs 5,788 crore (H1 Rs 11,454 crore, +21%); the store count reaches 1,342 after its 1,000th Zudio opening.
**IDFC First Bank** — Q2 FY27 loans grow 20.4% YoY to Rs 3,13,864 crore and deposits 17.0% to Rs 3,23,697 crore, excluding Rs 24,885 crore of leveraged FCNR(B); CASA ratio 51.3%.
**Sammaan Capital** — Q2 FY27 disbursements of about Rs 6,000 crore, against Rs 3,875 crore in Q1, with AUM above Rs 59,000 crore from Rs 56,239 crore at June-end.
**Suryoday Small Finance Bank** — Q2 FY27 gross advances up 34.6% YoY to Rs 14,972 crore and deposits up 35.0% to Rs 16,184 crore, with GNPA at 2.9% against 9.3% a year earlier.
**CreditAccess Grameen** — September-quarter AUM up 19.5% YoY to Rs 30,946 crore and disbursements up 19.4% to Rs 6,355 crore, with PAR 90+ easing to 1.1% from 1.5% in June.
**Marico** — Q2 FY27 update: India underlying volume growth touched double digits and international grew in the teens in constant currency; consolidated revenue is expected to grow in double digits.
**Metropolis Healthcare** — Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue grew about 15% YoY on double-digit patient and test volume growth, with EBITDA margins improving both YoY and QoQ.
**JSW Energy** — adds 1,694 MW since April 2026, including ~1.4 GW of renewables, taking installed capacity to 15,147 MW and its FY27 3 GW renewable target to about 46% done.
**ACME Solar Holdings** — commissions a further 66.68 MW of solar at its Bikaner, Rajasthan hybrid project (COD 7 October), taking it to 133.36 MW of 300 MW contracted with NTPC.
**BMW Industries** — commissions its colour coating line, the first phase of a Rs 803 crore greenfield downstream steel complex at Bokaro, with ~Rs 60 crore capitalised on the line.
**Shilp Gravures** — sets up its Unit-II gravure-cylinder facility in Bengaluru, raising manufacturing capacity by over 19%.
**Hi-Tech Pipes** — records its highest-ever quarterly sales volume, 1,65,016 MT in Q2 FY27 (+32% YoY), taking H1 to 3,21,152 MT (+29%).
**Steel Exchange India** — produces a record ~25,095 MT of re-bars in September and ~69,617 MT in the September quarter, its highest monthly and quarterly output.
**PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery** — Q2 FY27 revenue excluding gold sales rises 46.25% YoY to Rs 1,205.40 million; the store count reaches 38.
**WeWork India** — opens Infinix Palladium in Whitefield, Bengaluru and Millennium Towers in Wakad, Pune, adding ~2.25 lakh sq ft and 4,500+ desks.
**Accord Transformer & Switchgear** — H1 FY27 revenue of Rs 52.68 crore, up 90.07% YoY, with Rs 77 crore of orders received and an order book of Rs 173 crore at 30 September.
**Capital Trust** — its gold-loan business now runs six branches disbursing Rs 5-6 crore a month, with cumulative disbursements above Rs 45 crore and gold and secured-loan AUM of Rs 35 crore.
**SEPC** — Madras High Court lifts attachment on **Rs 154 crore of receivables** after a Rs 149.5 crore settlement paid entirely by another party under a 2015 indemnity; nil cash outflow for SEPC.
distress_risk: **BGR Energy Systems** — signs a Master Restructuring Agreement with NARCL over **Rs 3,736 crore of debt** (Rs 1,245 crore sustainable, repayable by September 2030); NARCL is to receive 20% of the equity, subject to corporate and regulatory approvals.

**SAB Events & Governance Now Media** — pays all outstanding PPIRP costs and dues to financial and operational creditors under its NCLT-approved pre-packaged resolution plan, completing its payment obligations.
**Opto Circuits (India)** — NCLT Bengaluru approves the CoC's replacement of its Resolution Professional with Waterfall Insolvency Professional (Ms. Shirley Mathew) in the company's ongoing CIRP.
**Reliance Communications Limited** — Reliance Communications Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
open_offers: **Hiliks Technologies Ltd** — FROM THE PUBLIC SHAREHOLDERS OF HILIKS BY ENACT TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED open offer for 26.0% (36.92 lakh shares) at Rs 72 vs CMP 61.97 (+16.2%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); **TENDER - offer above market**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 63 cr
credit_rating_changes: **Indian Overseas Bank** — India Ratings upgrades its Basel III Tier II bonds and long-term issuer rating to **IND AA+ from AA**, outlook revised to Stable from Positive.
**Sunil Healthcare** — Brickwork rates its long-term bank facilities BWR BBB-/Stable and short-term BWR A3, up from CARE BB+ and CARE A4+ previously.
other_notable: **Popular Vehicles and Services** — promoters sign a family settlement under which John K. Paul (20.39% holder) steps away from the businesses from 1 October, with Francis K. Paul and Naveen Philip leading; the company is not a party.
**Deep Health AI India** — board approves buying, by assignment from Kshitij Polyline, a debt owed by Sparion Infrastructure with its security, for **Rs 10.35 crore** _(~45.7% of mcap)_.
**Leading Leasing Finance and Investment** — withdraws its in-principle applications to BSE and MSE for 35.71 crore shares on conversion of an existing loan and 70.94 crore convertible warrants.
